Carbon fixation pathways and designated metabolic modules used in this study

Schematic overview of carbon fixation pathways and designated metabolic modules used in this study. Anaplerotic pathways are shown with gray arrows. Modules related to transporters are not included. Only pathways that were detected in recovered FSGD MAGs/SAGs are represented. KEGG orthologies (KOs) encoding the hydroxy-propionate-hydroxy-butyrate pathway (HPHB) were not detected in FSGD MAGs/SAGs and the pathway is not included. Abbreviations are as follows, PAT-ACK: phosphate acetyltransferase-acetate kinase; WLP & rGly/Ser: Wood-Ljungdahl pathway and reductive glycine/serine; CBB: Calvin-Benson-Bassham cycle, rTCA: reductive tricarboxylic acid/reductive citrate cycle; 3HP: 3-hydroxypropionate bi-cycle
